title: Sorceresses by the Portal
description: Four women in flowing red and purple gowns sit and stand around an ornate blue and gold chaise lounge in a dark mystical room. One transparent ghostly figure appears behind the couch while the others cast spells with glowing hands, surrounded by floating candles, magical particles, and a large arched window revealing a fiery red sky over a frozen sea with a distant dark castle.
prompt: Four women wearing elegant red and purple gowns with long flowing dark hair, one ghostly translucent sorceress standing behind an ornate blue velvet chaise lounge with gold trim, the others sitting and standing while casting spells with glowing magical energy between their hands, floating candles and colorful magical particles in the air, dark mystical room with an arched window showing a dramatic red sunset over a frozen icy ocean with broken ice floes and a silhouetted dark castle in the distance, atmospheric fantasy scene, detailed digital painting
